name: Imatinib (GIST, adjuvant and advanced)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.KIT: mutation predicts response (category 1 first-line for KIT-mutant GIST)
biomarkers.PDGFRA: most PDGFRA mutations are imatinib-sensitive EXCEPT exon 18 D842V, which is imatinib-resistant
biomarkers.note: Imatinib is the preferred first-line tyrosine kinase inhibitor for KIT-mutant or PDGFRA-mutant GIST (excluding PDGFRA exon 18 D842V). KIT exon 9 mutations respond less well at 400 mg/day and are the group for whom the source-stated 800 mg/day (400 mg twice daily) is selected. PDGFRA D842V responds to avapritinib and is unlikely to respond to imatinib or most other approved GIST TKIs. SDH-deficient and NF1-associated GIST that lack KIT/PDGFRA mutations are generally imatinib-insensitive. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors, GIST-B (Principles of Mutation Testing) and GIST-D (Principles of Systemic Therapy), and DeVita 12th ed.

supportiveCare: Continuous daily oral dosing; no defined cycle count in the advanced setting - continue until progression or intolerance.
Adjuvant setting: continue for 3 years after resection of intermediate-to-high-risk GIST per DeVita 12th ed. (line 118249) and Standard Guidelines (NCCN) GIST v1.2026.
Antiemetic/G-CSF prophylaxis not routinely required for oral imatinib monotherapy.
monitoring: fluid retention / periorbital and peripheral edema assessment (imatinib class effect)
clinical/radiographic response assessment (CT; Choi or RECIST criteria)

doseModificationRules.text: Source supports imatinib 800 mg/day (400 mg twice daily) for KIT exon 9-mutant advanced GIST (DeVita line 118228; NCCN gist lines 1655-1667).
Widely used option is dose escalation to 800 mg/day (DeVita line 118414); alternatively switch to second-line sunitinib. Obtain clinical review.

doseModificationRules.condition: significant hepatotoxicity, grade 3-4 edema/fluid retention, or grade 3-4 cytopenia
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and resume at a reduced dose per labeling; obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: Imatinib
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. (line 118304) and Standard Guidelines (NCCN) GIST v1.2026 (gist lines 1442, 1487, 1646). Imatinib 400 mg PO once daily, given continuously (represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle). DOSE ESCALATION: for KIT exon 9-mutant GIST the source states 800 mg/day given as 400 mg twice daily (DeVita line 118228; NCCN gist lines 1655, 1659, 1667); the same 800 mg/day escalation is a source-stated option on progression at 400 mg (DeVita line 118414). ADJUVANT DURATION: adjuvant imatinib is given for 3 years after resection of intermediate-to-high-risk GIST (DeVita line 118249; NCCN gist line 1487, 3-year adjuvant). No ISMP tall-man form. Monitor for periorbital/peripheral edema and fluid retention, hepatotoxicity (LFTs), and cytopenias.

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 118304 (standard daily dose of imatinib is 400 mg); line 118228 (800 mg daily for advanced GIST with exon 9 KIT mutation); line 118414 (on progression at 400 mg, widely used option is to increase to 800 mg daily)
